born on the first word: the door's descriptor lives in the URL (/page/new + params), reload-safe by construction; nothing is written until `birth`
the door declares the room's KIND (prose or screenplay); a screenplay door births on arrival, since choosing Screenplay is a commitment about what the document is
birth: one synchronous call, the only place an unborn surface becomes a row, with its content written in the same act (never create-empty-then-save)
ink is content, so a first stroke births the page with its strokes in the same act
relationships of the same act are applied here, so the row and its relationship are never observable apart; the pin can come from the address, so it survives a reload
the swipe: a pure slide (both cards opaque, never a cross-fade), about 280 ms; reduced motion is an instant cut
the caret lands in the card, so arrows step only while it is empty; PageUp/PageDown and the chevrons always step; outside the editor the arrows step
the way back: one session-scoped slot (sessionStorage) for scroll, caret and mode; the latest departure wins; a same-tab reload keeps the chip, by design
the ONE word counter: text is read through withoutFontMarks first (a span's inner space would count); the server counts the same way (polish10-wordcount.mjs holds them equal)
the words, never a span's marks
the Typewriter menu's adjustments; every default reproduces today's behaviour, so an older stored blob resolves unchanged

the pure read every Draft/Screenplay consumer asks: this page's saved value, else the theme's default for an empty page, else off; no side effect
once per page mount, opening into Draft: resolves and saves this page's own value, never mirrored into the shared field
